name: 14-not-the-minivan-desktop
prompt:
Create ONE completed Midlife Survivors title-screen illustration, scene14, desktop. WIDE LANDSCAPE16:9 canvas, EXACT1920x1080. ALL hero/kid/HOA or car/action sits in the UPPER-RIGHT rectangle x950-1850,y100-470, as first guide's green zone. Keep every important face/body/vehicle inside that rectangle; they occupy most of its width, not a big group in image center. Left third is low-contrast neighboring lawn/street with no characters. Bottom half y500-1080 is calm lawn, sidewalk/street so menu tiles can cover it.
REFERENCE ROLES: First image is ONLY the composition mask: green is where visible action goes, dark is quiet environment. DO NOT PAINT the mask/rectangles/colors as a diagram. Second image is house/town design, NOT a panel layout, ignore its old noisy ground textures. Third is exact cast/prop identity, NOT a character collage. Fourth image is the real title UI guide, ONLY spatial reference; NEVER render UI, labels, buttons, borders, logos or any of its writing. Turn all this into ONE continuous believable suburban environment.
SCENE: Same orange house on a clear autumn afternoon. The two-car garage door flies upward. The red/russet Midlife Crisis V8 convertible with angry HEADLIGHT EYES bursts down the driveway in a WHEELIE: rear wheels touch driveway, front wheels visibly raised, NO DRIVER, empty two seats. Dust and a few maple leaves trail behind. Inside the open double garage, beige family minivan remains parked in LEFT bay; RIGHT bay is EMPTY with a faint car-shaped dust outline. ONE9-to-5er hero stands beside driveway, shocked, black rectangular glasses/messy brown-gray hair/white short-sleeve shirt/loose red tie/khaki trousers; his orange mug splashes COFFEE, tie blows sideways. His son in lavender hoodie stands on sidewalk holding a TOY STEERING WHEEL, laughing. In the house's kitchen window the living MATH HOMEWORK worksheet boss glares out, paper face, pencil and crooked star; ONLY abstract wavy pencil marks, no real words/numbers. Keep all geometry believable: garage behind car, a single driveway running from it to street, hero off to one side, kid safely on sidewalk. Slapstick, not danger/injury. Exactly one hero and one kid, no extra people or passengers.
STYLE: crisp handmade16-bit pixel art with hard readable pixel clusters, slight top-down3/4 perspective matching the sprites. Clean broad flat color areas,2-3 hue-shifted tones per material,1px-equivalent navy outlines on objects, deliberate readable details. Bright grass in simple sage clumps, NO speckled grass/noise/dithering everywhere. Upper-left clear autumn light, contact shadows allowed, NEUTRAL WHITE BALANCE. Palette ONLY #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #EF9347 #C45C4B #BFA8CF #F1B5BF. No sepia, golden haze or film tint. NO blur, antialiasing, realistic or3D rendering. No magenta areas.
Zero text, letters, numbers, logos, brands, license plates, signatures, readable signs or watermarks anywhere. Lemonade sign and house-number spots are BLANK. Trees/fall leaves may be coffee-orange/russet but do not tint the whole scene. Quiet areas remain visibly drawn, lower contrast, no vignette or faded photographic fog. Main action placement is the first priority.
correction:
OUTPAINT ONLY the flat MAGENTA missing background in this already composed pixel-art title scene. The full canvas size/aspect must stay 1920x1080 landscape16:9. Existing non-magenta art is locked: keep all figures, faces, house, car, lemonade stand, rock, minivan, worksheet-window cameo, expressions, colors, outlines and positions EXACTLY where they are. DO NOT zoom, recenter, crop or enlarge the existing scene. It has already been scaled uniformly to fit a title-screen menu.
Replace every magenta pixel with a seamless continuation of the environment, joining naturally to the existing edges. The left blank region continues low-contrast neighboring yards, distant trees and street. Bottom becomes a wide calm slate-blue street, matching the street already visible at the existing image's lower edge. Far right is quiet environment continuation. ALL existing active figures remain inside upper-right x950-1850,y100-470.
No new characters, vehicles, enemies, signs or important objects. Keep new background LOW DETAIL and LOW CONTRAST; broad clean pixel color fields, no fine grass noise, no repeated tiny textures. Crisp16-bit pixel clusters, neutral white balance, no sepia/gold haze. Match this image's navy outlines and warm autumn palette; base palette only #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #EF9347 #C45C4B #BFA8CF #F1B5BF. No magenta remains in finished art. No UI, frames, labels, text, letters, numbers, logos, brands or watermarks. Keep the existing blank lemonade sign blank.
workflow: Separate desktop and phone compositions. Uniform crop only, no aspect distortion. Final 3px nearest-neighbor blocks, 12-color PNG master; JPG quality 88.
